base: Use the detective from the attached reference image as the main character: same fedora hat with gold band, dark navy trench coat, face mostly in shadow under the hat brim, cinematic semi-realistic digital painting style exactly like the reference. Dark navy palette with warm gold rim light. Vertical 4:5 composition. Keep the top 22 percent and bottom 32 percent of the image dark and uncluttered for text overlay. scenes: Scene: on a rocky mountain cliff at dusk, the detective crouches and examines with a magnifying glass a large golden eagle perched calmly on a rock, its beak and talons intact.
Scene: in an old 1890s school classroom, the detective holds up an old paper school report card (blank, unreadable) under a lamp; behind him a chalkboard with faint unreadable chalk marks.

Scene: inside a space station, the detective in his coat and hat floats by a round window and looks through a magnifying glass at planet Earth below; clouds and continents, no visible wall or lines on the surface.
Scene: at night under a huge glowing full moon, the detective stands calmly at the entrance of a quiet, almost empty hospital emergency department, looking at his pocket watch.
Scene: on a rainy city night, the detective holds a black umbrella and looks up at a tall skyscraper whose spire is being struck by lightning, a second lightning bolt forming nearby.
Scene: in a dim old train carriage at night, the detective covers a big yawn with his hand while two stylized passengers across from him start yawning too.

Scene: the detective in a dim candle-lit 19th-century museum hall, holding a measuring tape up beside a life-size Napoleon-era military uniform with a bicorne hat displayed on a mannequin; the uniform is clearly about the same height as the detective's shoulder. Old oil portraits in the dark background.
